cohort: 103 adolescents and 2291 women aged 20 to 34 years who gave birth at Campbelltown and Liverpool hospitals within South West Sydney, Australia
finding: Adolescents experience similar birth outcomes to older mothers, including rates of perinatal mortality, small for gestational age, and Apgar scores, although they have lower blood pressure throughout pregnancy.
mod_finding: Adolescents had lower rates of cesarean section delivery.
